quantum-fabric.title: Quantum Fabric
quantum-fabric.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 raster wallpaper for the native Limine UEFI boot menu, target dimensions 1920 x 1080.
Reference image role: the supplied screenshot is ONLY a layout/occupancy reference showing native Limine text at top-centre (x40–60%, y10–19%) and the boot-entry list around the centre (x33–65%, y46–54%). Do not copy its right-heavy portal, logo placement, text, mock entries, grid or composition.
Design goal: a fresh technological universe shaped by artificial intelligence, sophisticated DreamLab visual identity. Composition must work around the existing central menu rather than moving or painting it. Reserve a broad uninterrupted very dark, softly graduated negative-space zone x18–82%, y35–70%, and a quiet dark top-centre x30–70%, y7–22%. These are invisible composition constraints, NOT visible panels, boxes or placeholders. Place visual interest around the margins; restrained depth and detail, purposeful symmetry or balanced framing.
Verified dls-theme palette: dark navy #071723 / near-black, primary TEAL #00A49A (green teal, not cyan), violet #8B5CF6, sparse acid-yellow #D9FF00 accents. Light may have natural tonal variation; keep teal recognisable. High-end cinematic 3D concept artwork, precise materials, controlled bloom, convincing fine details.
No text at all, no logo, slogans, letters, numbers, fake telemetry, menu rows, buttons, selector bars, cards, UI overlays, watermark, humanoid robots or brain illustration. Artwork only; functional text is rendered later by Limine. One coherent image, no collage or comparison board.
Direction name: Quantum Fabric.
Scene: a vast precision-engineered photonic processor landscape under a deep navy cosmic sky, seen from a slightly elevated wide camera with no tilt. The artificial intelligence appears as thousands of miniature dark ceramic compute tiles and optical waveguides organized into a refined technological terrain. Keep the entire processor landscape BELOW y74% of the frame: black stepped platforms at the bottom corners, elegant teal signal traces receding toward a very low horizon, violet resonance details, and a few tiny yellow computation points. Two exceptionally slim vertical photonic structures can rise along the extreme edges but never into the central menu zone. The upper 70% is expansive dark, nearly uniform navy space with only faint atmospheric depth and very sparse peripheral stars; no bright sun, planet or central object. The layout should feel rigorously designed and architectural, with an ultra-low horizon that supports rather than cuts across the central Limine menu. Restrained futuristic materials and cinematic quality, accurate perspective, no retro neon grid, no huge central chip, no city signage.

Direction name: Sentient Atlas.
Scene: an abstract celestial atlas produced by a vast artificial intelligence, an unusually refined minimal cosmic visualization. Deep navy space with sparse, exquisitely drawn teal and violet constellation networks concentrated in the four outer corners and along the lateral frame edges. Hairline arcs and tiny prismatic nodes suggest learned relationships and trajectories across a technological universe, rather than a literal printed star map or interface. Imagine layered translucent glass filaments floating at different depths in the dark. Use asymmetry in individual networks but equal visual weight on both sides, opening onto a broad perfectly calm dark central field. A few disconnected faint network fragments may occupy the bottom 15%; no line, luminous dot or mesh crosses the main menu's central safe zone or top-centre help area. Tiny acid-yellow nodes are very rare and meaningful accents. Minimal, spacious, computational and cosmic, closer to luxurious scientific visualization than a busy sci-fi dashboard. No solid machines, no planet, no portal, no waveform in the centre, no labels or graphic legend.
